name: Short Cut Prosciutto-Cheese Tortellini with Asparagus, Basil Pesto & Garlic Toast

ingredients.name: prosciutto & cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F and arrange rack in the center position. Place toast on the countertop to thaw slightly. Separate toast slices, arrange on a baking sheet pan, and place in the preheated oven. Bake until golden and toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.

Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch long pieces. Once the water is boiling, uncover the pan, add tortellini and asparagus, then stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta and asparagus are just tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and return to the pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch asparagus
1 (10 oz) pkg prosciutto & cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add pesto to the pan. Return to medium-high heat and cook, stirring often, until warmed through, about 30 seconds. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then remove from heat.
Divide tortellini and asparagus between plates or bowls. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!
